status_summary: No 340B statute has been enacted. H.R. 5256, the 340B ACCESS Act, was introduced on 2025-09-10 and referred to Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means; it would define eligible patients, require sliding-fee patient discounts at hospital covered entities, add covered entity data submissions and set civil penalties. A bipartisan Senate group introduced the SUSTAIN 340B Act on 2026-08-05, with annual reporting and a patient financial assistance policy, according to a trade journal. Separately, HRSA's voluntary rebate model pilot (notice of 2025-08-01) was blocked by the District of Maine on 2025-12-29 and vacated and remanded on 2026-02-10; HRSA issued a request for information on 2026-02-17 and a revised pilot notice on 2026-08-03 with a 2027-01-01 earliest start.

HRSA publishes a notice revising the pilot, with manufacturer plans due 2026-08-24 and a 2027-01-01 earliest start.
A bipartisan group of senators introduces the SUSTAIN 340B Act, with annual covered entity reporting and a patient financial assistance policy.
